chapter_mission: Stage the Hapan royal wedding: Jacen present in his dual role as Jedi and as Tenel Ka's secret partner; an assassination attempt is made on the Hapan royal party.
chapter_turn: The Corellian crisis escalates from political to kinetic at an ostensibly peripheral venue — the Hapan wedding — which commits the Jedi and Alliance to operational responses.

scene_plan.purpose: The wedding ceremony; assassins move on the royal party; Jacen intercepts.
Aftermath — identification of the cell; Tenel Ka brief moment; commitment to the broader Corellian investigation.

exit_vector: Assassination attempt interrupted; Jacen's presence pivotal; the Hapan/Alliance/Corellian lines of communication cross-hatched by the incident.
notes: Tenel Ka peripheral on-page. Allana unnamed and unpresent. Jacen's efficiency in the combat is again slightly more surgical than a conventional Jedi's would be.
